name: Ferienwohnung Tirol
beschreibung:
Picturesquely located in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Tirol offers holidaymakers an ideal sanctuary featuring comfortable bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a private balcony.

Lake Thiersee promises swimming in summer, while winter brings scenic snowshoe trails and cross-country tracks.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Tirol in Thiersee provides cosy living comfort and lakeside proximity in Kufsteinerland.
